    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:

            raise ValueError("All logp values must be nonpositive")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, horizon) or logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, horizon):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    # Normalize weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
